entry.title: New: Resolution 438 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Res. 438-25 withdrawn by introducer - 01/07/26
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE HAWAI‘I ISLE POLICE ACTIVITIES LEAGUE 3 ON 3 BASKETBALL TOURNAMENT

Transfers $2,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 3)

Latest action: Council: Res. 438-25 withdrawn by introducer - 01/07/26
